stem: A student places ice cubes into a beaker filled with warm water. Which statement **BEST** identifies and explains the change that will occur to the ice cubes?

options.label: A
options.text: They will undergo a physical change to the state of matter, from solid to liquid.

options.label: B
options.text: They will undergo a chemical change that permanently changes the shape of the ice cubes in the liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: They will undergo a physical change caused by a transfer of heat from the ice cubes to the liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: They will undergo a chemical change because a new substance, made up of a solid and liquid, is formed.
